items.text: He names health care, education, and property taxes as his top issues. He has proposed a state-matched health savings account program to help low-income families. To lower property taxes, he suggests offering tax discounts to residents who live in their homes for more than a decade. His education plan includes launching "learn & earn labs" where public high school students can earn money or credit while working on projects for businesses. His campaign website calls for increasing medical price transparency and expanding access to telehealth and urgent care.
